_doc: Road standards check (bim-compiler prompts/CIVIL_HIGHWAY_JELAPANG.md §MC). Every limit is read from the cited JKR document; page = printed page number. Read by viewer/road_check.js. Never type a limit here without its clause.

ATJ_2A.title: Arahan Teknik (Jalan) 2A/85 (Pindaan 2019) Manual on Traffic Control Devices: Standard Traffic Signs

ATJ_2B.title: Arahan Teknik (Jalan) 2B/85 (Pindaan 2019) Manual on Traffic Control Devices: Standard Traffic Signs Application

ATJ_2D.title: Arahan Teknik (Jalan) 2D/85 (Pindaan 2019) Manual on Traffic Control Devices: Road Marking and Delineation

_area_type_note: Not in the model data. ATJ 2B §1.3 sets 1.8 m (rural roadside; warning/regulatory signs on expressways or divided roads) and 2.2 m (urban/business/residential). Change to "urban" when the road is urban. The report prints which one ran.

selectors._note: Which data the rules read. Project template field names live here, not in code.

measurement._note: Geometry method settings — OURS, not from any standard. Printed in the report as assumptions.

road_rules.name: sign_mounting_height
road_rules.label: Sign mounting height
road_rules.text: Traffic signs erected at the roadside in rural areas shall be mounted at a height not less than 1.8 m above the level of the roadway edge, measured from the bottom of the sign. In urban ... not less than 2.2 m. ... a secondary sign ... mounted below a major sign ... not less than 1.5 m.
road_rules.formula: h = bottom of sign face − roadway edge level

film_status.why: the road-edge level can pick a higher road piece (embankment / other carriageway) — first run read heights down to −6.02 m

road_rules.name: obstruction_marker_height
road_rules.label: Obstruction marker height
road_rules.text: When erected, this marker should have vertical clearance of 1.2 m above the level of the roadway edge, measured from the bottom of the marker.
road_rules.formula: h = bottom of marker − roadway edge level

film_status.why: same road-edge level method as sign mounting height

road_rules.name: sign_lateral_clearance
road_rules.label: Sign lateral clearance
road_rules.text: Traffic signs should not be placed less than 0.6 m from the edge of road shoulder, or if none, 3.6 m from the edge of the travelled way. ... [Chevron delineator] a lateral clearance of 1.8m is recommendable.
road_rules.caveat: Measured to the nearest ROAD-file solid. Whether that solid's edge is the shoulder edge, a kerb or the travelled way is not in the data; the 0.6 m shoulder case is applied.
road_rules.formula: c = plan distance, sign edge → nearest road solid

film_status.why: all 138 signs read 0.00 m — every sign foot sits inside some ROAD-file solid (verge/kerb pieces?)

road_rules.name: chevron_spacing
road_rules.label: Chevron delineator spacing
road_rules.text: The Chevron Delineator signs, when used, shall be erected on the outside of a curve, laterally 6 m apart from each other, in line with and at right angles to, approaching traffic.
road_rules.caveat: Nearest other chevron delineator; tolerance from measurement.spacing_tolerance_m (ours).
road_rules.formula: s = distance to the nearest other chevron delineator

film_status.why: the distance is measured; whether "laterally 6 m apart" means nearest neighbour is not yet checked against ATJ 2B Fig. 10

road_rules.name: rrpm_spacing
road_rules.label: Road stud (RRPM) spacing

rows.application: Centre / lane / no-passing / edge lines, median of divided road — on curves
Centre / lane / no-passing / edge lines, median of divided road — on straight

road_rules.caveat: Which application a stud group serves is not in the data; a group is flagged only when its spacing matches no row.
road_rules.formula: s = median nearest-stud distance inside a stud group

film_status.why: stud spacing measured 1.00 m in every group; it matches no Table 4.2 row — which application a group serves is not in the data

atj2a_codes._note: Sign codes found as headings in the ATJ 2A/85 (Pindaan 2019) text (pdftotext -layout), value = text line. Codes absent here may still be in the document as images, or in ATJ 2C (guide signs) — absence is 'not verified', never a finding.

_film_status_note: §ALTC_CHECKS — the tracking list (user 2026-10-06: "keep track which is valid and speculative"). The film shows each check as a worked formula tagged with this status. Change a status only with its reason. formula = our display text, not the standard.
